AiSearch.title: Multi-stage Streaming API
AiSearch.summary: This topic describes how to use the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI software development kit (SDK) to invoke the multi-stage streaming API V3 for general search, along with parameter explanations.
AiSearch.description:
Provides streaming results for two stages—common_search and post_retrieval—for Customers to use as needed.  
General search results (common_search): The original search results, covering key fields such as title, dynamic summary, body content, source website, and Published At.  
Post-retrieval processing (post_retrieval): Applies a reranking model to rerank and filter the common_search results from the previous stage. This improves the mean average precision (mAP) of result relevance (Context Relevancy) by approximately 5%, with an increase in Duration of about 110 ms.

GenericAdvancedSearch.summary: This topic describes how to invoke the GenericAdvancedSearch API by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI software development kit (SDK) and provides a parameter guide. Compared with GenericSearch, GenericAdvancedSearch offers improved retrieval from authoritative sites, supporting up to 40 retrieved results, thereby delivering better authority and data diversity. The response fields and format of this enhanced API are consistent with those of GenericAdvancedSearch.

ReadPageBasic.title: Static Page Parsing
ReadPageBasic.description:
1. When the HTTP status code (httpcode) of the target address is less than 500, it is counted as one valid request.  

2. If the content type (Content-Type) in the response header of the target address is application/pdf, the system automatically triggers PDF parsing (PDF file size must not exceed 20 MB). This operation is counted as an additional valid request.  

3. Trial terms: During the trial period, the API is limited to 5 queries per second (QPS); the trial quota is 1,000 requests per 30 days.

ReadPageScrape.summary:

2. The API starts parsing after all resources on the target page are fully loaded (the maximum waiting duration can be adjusted via the pageTimeout parameter). The overall Duration of the API call is significantly affected by the resource loading performance of the target site.
